observations: Luo Z, Zhao D. 2014 study of suture-bridge repair for quadriceps tendon rupture in uraemic patients; PubMed PMID 25073281.

entities.name: Suture-bridge repair outcomes
observations: In an uncontrolled series of 10 uraemic patients (14 knees), mean 16.3-month follow-up showed no reruptures or fixation loosening; mean Lysholm score rose from 19.5 to 84.6, and 13/14 knees had good or excellent KSS results.
Small case series without a comparator; findings suggest functional improvement but cannot establish superiority or definitive efficacy.
